messages:
deploy-bot: Preflight eval finished for release v2026.3 -> prod. Gate status: HOLD due to prompt/eval regression on summarizer prompt suite. Details: https://deploy/reports/3332221110 :eyes:

maria: on it. which metric is drifting?

sam: quick summary: summary_quality delta +6.2% (worse) on long-form tests, small-sample noise on brevity. full diff at the link.

lee: if it's long-form only, can we split route by profile? EU traffic already uses shorter max_tokens.

jordan: splitting routes is doable but needs a canary rollout change and extra ops runbook. change window in ~2h though.

ana-qa: ran focused eval (n=200) against baseline v2026.2 and head. Regression concentrated in 'newsletter' prompts; examples attached. No safety/HL issues.

maria: thanks @ana-qa. sounds like quality regression, not infra. product-eng any blockers for pinning v2026.2?

product-eng: pin is safest from product POV. Users rely on summary coherence for notifications. Not ok to bypass gate.

sam: ops: can we request a soft fallback (route 5% -> v2026.2) while we triage? That reduces user impact and avoids a full rollback.

jordan: ops note: our routing tier supports staged fallback but deploybot needs manual route-edit and approval. We can do 5% in 15m with runbook.

maria: two options: 1) pin prod to v2026.2 (fast, full revert) 2) staged 5% fallback + hotfix branch for model retune. Preference for staged fallback to reduce churn.

product-eng: staged fallback approved. No bypass of the gate. QA must sign off on hotfix before promotion.

sam: I'll open a hotfix branch and schedule focused eval loop. tagging @ana-qa for signoff criteria.

ana-qa: signoff checklist: (1) regression delta <1% on newsletter set (n=500), (2) smoke pass on edge-case prompts, (3) no new hallucination patterns. Will run after hotfix artifacts are ready.

deploy-bot: Action required: manual routing change request submitted by @sam. Approvers: maria, jordan. Use /deploy approve 3332221110-route to accept.

maria: approving the 5% staged fallback. please include rollback window and monitoring dashboard in the PR. :white_check_mark:

jordan: approved. ops will monitor latency and error-rate for 30m after route change.

sam: executing route change now. deploy-bot, please post status updates.

deploy-bot: Routing update started: 5% -> v2026.2 for summarizer routes. Status: in-progress.

deploy-bot: Routing update complete. 5% traffic shifted. Canary metrics baseline in <10m.

lee: making a note to add a temporary quant-profile toggle in case model size/quant changes correlate.

maria: good. sam, open release-note draft explaining staged fallback and next steps. Include ticket refs and hotfix ETA.

sam: will do. ETA hotfix candidate in 4h, QA sweep afterward.

product-eng: thanks team. keeping this thread as canonical for the gate decision.

maria: post-mortem action items: (a) add targeted prompt set to preflight for newsletter variants, (b) automate per-profile routing smoke, (c) add early-warning alerts on long-summary metrics. Assign owners in JIRA.

deploy-bot: Noted. Ticket created: RELE-4312 (staged fallback executed)
